---
title: "The exercise"
subtitle: "Analyst no. 6"
---

This page sets out the exercise of the one-day workshop, task by task, with the tool in which each task is done. The [background page](../../cases/europeanisation/index.qmd) presents the original study, the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026) and the five reanalyses in full, and it is the place to start if you have not read it. The tasks are done in the workspace that you download and open in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), while the deck of the day shows each step with its output. If your installation fails, the deck and the [browser lab](../../cases/europeanisation/lab.qmd), which runs the exercise in a browser tab with the data in place, carry the work, and both give the same numbers as the workspace.

## The tasks {#the-tasks}

The workshop takes all five tasks, Task 1 in Part 1, Task 2 in Part 2, Task 3 in Part 3, and Tasks 4 and 5 in Part 4, and the page of each part lists its steps. Each task below says what to do in the workspace and, where it differs, in the browser lab.
